snippet.title: A Day with Professor Zoltan | Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Investigate a mystery set in Professor Zoltan’s theater. Watch videos, examine letters, listen to recordings, and follow clues across the web in the first episode of Zoltan’s Game.

Play the first episode: https://zoltansgame.com/
Press inquiries: press@zoltansgame.com

AI tools were used in the game’s interface design, some in-game images, and voiceover production.
